Corvey, a former Benedictine abbey on the Weser near Höxter, is a UNESCO World Heritage site with a significant history. Founded in the 9th century as a Carolingian monastery, it developed into a cultural and economic center with a valuable library. After periods of crisis and Baroque reconstruction, the abbey was elevated to a principality in 1792, but lost its independence in 1803. heritage designation:UNESCO World Heritage Site.
